advisory.summary: ENG-26: claim resolves <home>/improvements before deriving its lock while add uses the unresolved path, so when the improvements directory itself (final path component) is a symlink the two commands lock different sibling files and a concurrent add can rewrite a just-claimed entry to ready. Ancestor symlinks (e.g. /var -> /private/var, symlinked FACTORY_HOME) still yield the same physical lock file, so the precondition is a symlinked backlog directory plus a concurrent add/claim window; consequence is a recoverable lost claim stamp, rated medium not high.
advisory.fix: Derive the lock from one canonical path in both add and claim (e.g. resolve in add too, or lock on the unresolved path in claim) and add a symlinked-directory regression test.

advisory.summary: ENG-23: two simultaneous contenders recovering the same stale backlog lock can both enter, a limitation of lock.acquire that pre-dates this change and is documented at lock.py lines 124-125; it requires a crashed holder plus a simultaneous race on recovery.
advisory.fix: If it matters, upgrade lock.acquire to fcntl.flock as its docstring proposes, with a concurrent stale-recovery test.

advisory.summary: ENG-26: export() replaces <repo>-<branch>.json unconditionally, so a branch deliberately named '<branch>.<12-hex repo hash>.retro.<kind>.<subject>' would overwrite a claimed Retro entry; the collision requires embedding the exact repo-path hash in a self-chosen local branch name, and the delta made it rarer than the round-1 name format.
advisory.fix: Have export refuse to replace an existing file whose kind is retro (or whose status is claimed).

advisory.summary: ENG-18: test_claim_serializes_with_add_under_home_lock uses sleep(0.3) plus a liveness check; a slow child start can make a non-locking claim pass, and the 3 s communicate timeout can flake under load.
advisory.fix: Synchronize deterministically with the child reaching its lock attempt (e.g. poll for an observable wait signal) before releasing, then assert completion only after release.

advisory.summary: Checked tasks T001 and T005 still state the old name '<repo-name>-<branch>.retro.<kind>.<subject>.json' while plan.md, DESIGN.md and the code use the '<repo-hash>' form; documentation drift only.
advisory.fix: Update T001/T005 acceptance text to the revised naming contract and legacy-entry handling.
